name: Gather 12 solar panel arrays for Balthazar
description: Balthazar needs <color_yellow>12 solar panel arrays</color> to stabilize the power to their bunker.

dialogue.describe: The power in my bunker is failing and I need <color_yellow>12 solar panel arrays</color> to stabilize them.
dialogue.advice: Most commercial buildings have some solar panel arrays or, if we're lucky, you might find a solar farm.
dialogue.inquire: Power is holding for now but I need those panels soon.
